messages.subject: Difficult to get indirect effect
parts:
I have been finding it difficult to generate the indirect effect of CO2, Fertilizer and Cultivar on lignin, Cp, Mg, N. I am new to SEM, and I need help. Thank you as I look forward to your responses. Below is the code I have been trying.

model='
ligninN ~ CN + P + Mg + N + Lignin +Mn
Cp ~ CO2 + Fertilization + Cultivar + NSC + ligninN + Lignin + CN
'
#This code is to run the model
model
path = sem(model,data=pathdataL)
summary(path, standardized = T, fit.measures=T, rsquare=T, modindices=T)
semPaths(path, whatLabels ="std", layout = "spring", color = "green", edge.label.cex =
           0.95,)
fitmeasures(path)

#This code is to specify the direct and indirect effects
# Specify the SEM model
model2 <- '
# Decomposition variables
LIGNINN =~ a*CO2 + c*NSC + d*ligninN + f*Lignin

# Predictors
NSC ~ e*CN + k*ligninN + l*Lignin

# Indirect effects
indirect_LIGNIN := e * c
indirect_cn := k * a
indirect_nsc := l * f
indirect_LIGNINN := e * d
'
model2
path2 = sem(model2,data=pathdataL)
summary(path2, standardized = T, fit.measures=T, rsquare=T, modindices=T)
fit2 <-sem(model2, data= pathdataL)

# Summarize the results
summary(fit2)

semPaths(path2, whatLabels ="std", layout = "spring", edge.color = "green", color= "gray",
         sizeMan=10, sizeLat=10, edge.label.cex = 1.2,)

#This line is to assess the model fitness
fitmeasures(path2)
#This code is to check if any path should be specified in the model
modificationindices(path, sort. = TRUE)
